category_a_business.wikipedia_excerpt: Organon & Co. is an American pharmaceutical company originally founded in Oss, The Netherlands and now headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. Organon specializes in the following core therapeutic fields: reproductive medicine, contraception, psychiatry, hormone replacement therapy (HRT), and anesthesia. Organon produces all its products outside of the United States but receives a third of its revenue from the United States.
